definition: A gene is a set of instructions in your cells. Genes help the body grow and work. You get one copy of each gene from each parent.
source: Authored for this prototype from general medical knowledge; no third-party text copied; clinical sign-off pending.

definition: A variant is a difference in the spelling of a gene. Many variants are harmless. Some change how a gene works.
source: Authored for this prototype from general medical knowledge; no third-party text copied; clinical sign-off pending.

definition: A carrier has one changed copy of a gene and one usual copy. For most inherited conditions that need two changed copies, a carrier has no symptoms.
